objects.name: corex_task_operations
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "corex_task_operations" ("id" varchar not null, "request_key" varchar not null, "payload_hash" varchar not null, "kind" varchar not null, "result_ref" text not null, "restore_epoch" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: corex_task_operations_kind_ck
objects.definition: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_operations_kind_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_operations BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.kind IN ('createProject','createSprint','recordTime','materialize','completionCapture') THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid kind') END; END

objects.name: corex_task_operations_payload_hash_ck
objects.definition: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_operations_payload_hash_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_operations BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN length(NEW.payload_hash) = 64 AND NEW.payload_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid payload_hash') END; END

objects.name: corex_task_operations_request_key_uq
objects.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "corex_task_operations_request_key_uq" on "corex_task_operations" ("request_key")

objects.name: corex_task_operations_restore_epoch_ck
objects.definition: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_operations_restore_epoch_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_operations BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN length(NEW.restore_epoch) = 64 AND NEW.restore_epoch NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid restore_epoch') END; END

objects.name: migrations
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "migrations" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "migration" varchar not null, "batch" integer not null)

objects.name: sqlite_sequence
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

objects.name: tsk_projects
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "tsk_projects" ("id" varchar not null, "workspace_id" varchar, "name" varchar not null, "description" text, "status" varchar not null default 'active', "owner_id" varchar, "starts_on" date, "due_on" date, "settings" text not null default '{}', "created_by" text not null, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "deleted_at" datetime, foreign key("owner_id") references "users"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("workspace_id") references "wsp_workspaces"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: tsk_sprints
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "tsk_sprints" ("id" varchar not null, "project_id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "goal" text, "status" varchar not null default 'planned', "starts_on" date not null, "ends_on" date not null, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key("project_id") references "tsk_projects"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: tsk_stages
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "tsk_stages" ("id" varchar not null, "project_id" varchar not null, "code" varchar not null, "name" text not null, "color" varchar, "position" integer not null default '0', "auto_status" varchar, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key("project_id") references "tsk_projects"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: tsk_stages_project_id_code_uq
objects.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "tsk_stages_project_id_code_uq" on "tsk_stages" ("project_id", "code")

objects.name: tsk_task_targets
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "tsk_task_targets" ("task_id" varchar not null, "entity_type" varchar not null, "entity_id" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key("task_id") references "tsk_tasks"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("task_id", "entity_type", "entity_id"))

objects.name: tsk_task_targets_entity_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX "tsk_task_targets_entity_ix" on "tsk_task_targets" ("entity_type", "entity_id")

objects.name: tsk_task_watchers
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "tsk_task_watchers" ("task_id" varchar not null, "user_id" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key("task_id") references "tsk_tasks"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("task_id", "user_id"))

objects.name: tsk_tasks
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "tsk_tasks" ("id" varchar not null, "workspace_id" varchar, "project_id" varchar, "sprint_id" varchar, "stage_id" varchar, "parent_id" varchar, "title" varchar not null, "description" text, "status" varchar not null default 'open', "priority" varchar not null default 'normal', "author_id" varchar, "assignee_id" varchar, "created_by" text not null, "starts_at" datetime, "due_at" datetime, "completed_at" datetime, "requires_acceptance" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "recurrence_rule_id" varchar, "recurrence_occurs_at" datetime, "estimate_minutes" integer, "spent_minutes" integer not null default '0', "position" numeric not null default '0', "search" text, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "deleted_at" datetime, foreign key("assignee_id") references "users"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("author_id") references "users"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("parent_id") references "tsk_tasks"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, foreign key("project_id") references "tsk_projects"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("sprint_id") references "tsk_sprints"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("stage_id") references "tsk_stages"("id") on delete set null on update no action, foreign key("workspace_id") references "wsp_workspaces"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: tsk_time_logs
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "tsk_time_logs" ("id" varchar not null, "task_id" varchar not null, "user_id" varchar not null, "minutes" integer not null, "spent_on" date not null, "comment" text, "source" varchar not null default 'manual', "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key("task_id") references "tsk_tasks"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict on update no action, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: tsk_time_logs_task_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX "tsk_time_logs_task_ix" on "tsk_time_logs" ("task_id")

objects.name: tsk_time_logs_user_ix
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX "tsk_time_logs_user_ix" on "tsk_time_logs" ("user_id", "spent_on")

objects.name: tsk_timers
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "tsk_timers" ("user_id" varchar not null, "task_id" varchar not null, "started_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "created_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "updated_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key("task_id") references "tsk_tasks"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete cascade on update no action, primary key ("user_id"))

objects.name: users
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "users" ("id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "deleted_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: wsp_workspace_members
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "wsp_workspace_members" ("id" varchar not null, "workspace_id" varchar not null, "user_id" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'active', foreign key("workspace_id") references "wsp_workspaces"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: wsp_workspace_members_workspace_id_user_id_unique
objects.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "wsp_workspace_members_workspace_id_user_id_unique" on "wsp_workspace_members" ("workspace_id", "user_id")

objects.name: wsp_workspaces
objects.definition: CREATE TABLE "wsp_workspaces" ("id" varchar not null, "slug" varchar not null, "deleted_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))

objects.name: wsp_workspaces_slug_unique
objects.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "wsp_workspaces_slug_unique" on "wsp_workspaces" ("slug")
